name: Challenge an idea before building it
steps: Answer each of those open questions yourself with the most reasonable assumption, and mark the assumptions the owner must confirm before anything is built.
Write the plan as one document in your answer: a short brief (who it is for, what it does and what it does not do), then a step-by-step build plan that says how each step will be checked.
Now act as a strict checker who did not write this plan. Check it against the idea and the risks above, list what must change before building, and say plainly whether it is ready.
